content:
Noelle (product): Heads-up  quick UX pass needed on Compliance table before next deploy. Items: retention preset wording, region dropdown label when unset, badge contrast (esp. colorblind), and export CTA copy. Can we thread feedback here?
Diego (design): Quick notes: current retention shows presets as "30d / 90d / 1y" which reads cryptic in a dense table row. Suggest human-friendly single-line: 'Data retained for 30 days. Learn more.' OR show preset label '30 days (default)'. Also region field shows an empty placeholder "Region" which looks like a bug.
Hannah (eng): Implementation constraints: export endpoint supports format query. We can default to CSV. Reordering DOM to match visual LTR order is straightforward. Small caveat: changing pill contrast may need SCSS variable update.
Pri (a11y): Contrast note: current BYOK pill uses blue + white text; for deuteranopia it can merge with other status tags. Propose adding a subtle key icon and an outline style for Redwood-managed, filled for BYOK, and ensure non-color cues (icon + label). Also ensure labels are full text, not icon-only.
Noelle (product): Good. For retention wording, prefer explicit human sentence. We must avoid implying per-workspace edits unless shipped. Rex, thoughts?
Rex (legal): Keep conservative. "Data retained for 30 days. Learn more." is fine. Confirm where "Learn more" links to; it must include exceptions. Avoid phrases like "default" without docs.
Diego (design): For region placeholder, propose showing "All regions" and if a workspace default exists show small gray tag "workspace default" as non-interactive hint. For the export CTA, current label is "Download audit log" confusing. Options: "Export filtered logs (CSV)" or "Export (CSV)". I prefer explicit: "Export filtered logs (CSV)".
Hannah (eng): We'll set CSV as default param if label includes it. Also can add a small dropdown chevron for format options. Backend supports `format=csv|json`.
Pri (a11y): Export flow must announce progress via a live region: e.g., "Export started (CSV)." Also the export button should have aria-label: "Export filtered logs, CSV format". Dropdown menu of formats must be keyboard accessible with `role=menu`.
Diego (design): KMS badge text options: 'Redwood-managed key' and 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)'. Tooltip: 'Customer-managed key stored in your KMS.' Keep it short. Tooltip must be reachable by keyboard.
Noelle (product): Ok settle on copy: retention -> 'Data retained for 30 days. Learn more.' region fallback -> 'All regions' badge labels as Diego suggested, export -> 'Export filtered logs (CSV)'. Pri to sign-off on accessibility checks.
Pri (a11y): I'll create a mini checklist for QA: focus order LTR, non-color indicators for key type (icon + text), tooltip `aria-describedby`, export live region announcement, and menu roles/labels.
Hannah (eng): I'll open a PR that: 1) updates copy, 2) swaps DOM order to region -> retention -> badges -> actions, 3) adjusts SCSS for pill styles (uses icon + label), 4) sets default export format to CSV. ETA: tomorrow AM.
design-bot: Figma updated: https://www.figma.com/file/unique123/compliance-ux-v7 (view)
Noelle (product): Thanks team. @Hannah paste PR link here when ready and @Pri please flag anything blocking. :thumbsup:
